Brief-claimed-by: session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb · batch #416 · 2026-10-28T00:53Z

Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Presented to the maintainer in batch #416 as item 3 of 3. Seat increment (re-verified on `origin/main` `eae9a588e7`):
- Premises hold: `git grep -c -E 'turbo-(build-core|typecheck|pack-smoke)-' origin/main -- .github/workflows/` counts 37 restore-key / key lines across `ci.yml` and `lint.yml`, so PR runs do restore these seeds; `prune-turbo-cache.mjs --site` is wired on exactly four jobs (Test Core, Build UI Deps, Type Check UI, Lint UI) and on none of the three seeds this card names. #26070 → A stands (PR runs carry no remote-cache token), so the seeds are the only cache a PR build has. The pool reading (10.30 GB, 2026-10-24) is still the latest the seat can cite.
- Half-state: `needs-user-decision` + `domain:devx`, as filed; the ruling's stroke returns it to `pm:queue` as #25452's step 2.
- Facets (the seat's block, re-read): ① A puts every Turbo seed under the one prune discipline already running; ② every PR restores these seeds today; ③ A fails loud (prune logs), B degrades silently; ④ A is wiring only, no script, no gate.
- The seat agrees with **A**. Not B (deletes the cache #26070 just named as the PR build's only cache) and not C (defers what the numbers already decide). Workload: devx · 1 PR Tier H (seed-save steps in `ci.yml` / `lint.yml`), then the pool re-read by whoever can reach `actions/cache/*`.
Prior rulings read: #26070 A (6417142465), #25452 directive (6385486517), #25523 (prune precedent); thread: #25452.

Ruling: batch #416 item 3 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-28T02:07Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batch #416 with 「同意」 — every seat letter. Brief 6457716808. Letter **A, prune, do not drop**: the Build Core, Type Check · workspace and pack-smoke per-sha seeds stay, and each seed-save step is wired behind `scripts/ci/prune-turbo-cache.mjs --site …` exactly as Test Core, Build UI Deps, Type Check UI and Lint UI are today, so a seed holds only the task entries its own run used. #25452's directive step 2 (6385486517, 「再去掉远程缓存已覆盖的 build-core/typecheck/pack-smoke 种子」) is rewritten by this ruling to "prune, not drop", because its premise fell with ruling #26070 → A (PR runs carry no remote-cache token; these seeds are the only cache a PR build has). Not B (deletes the PR build's only cache; cold Build Core measured 51 s → 4m30s) and not C (defers what the numbers already decide). "⛔ The pool limit is not raised here" stands.

What lands (card column): devx · 1 PR Tier H on `.github/workflows/ci.yml` / `lint.yml` seed-save steps — wiring only, no new script, no new gate; precedent #25523. The PR body records the first push run's `prune-turbo-cache:` lines for each of the three seeds (the measured post-prune size; the card's MB-scale figure is an extrapolation from Test Core). Then #25452 step 3, the pool reading after ≥ 5 merges, by whoever can read `actions/cache/*` (the seat container gets 403). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:devx`, p2, `area:devpath`); the devx seat dispatches it as #25452's step 2. A pointer goes on #25452. `Ruling-ref:` names this comment.

| `turbo-typecheck` | Type Check · workspace, run 40645073761, job 122671881753 | 151 task entries (2 summaries) | 55,374 files | **5,885.7 MB → 33.3 MB** | 32.8 MB upload |
| `turbo-pack-smoke` | Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in), PR #27067 run 40638841420, job 122651980265 | 116 task entries (1 summary) | 621 files | 148.7 MB → 54.9 MB | 53.1 MB upload |

**Reading.**
- The typecheck seed was the one that had grown: about 5.9 GB on disk before the prune, now 33 MB. The pool pressure #25452 measured mostly came from this one.
- The Build Core seed was already clean: the prune dropped nothing.
- One observation, not a defect today: the typecheck prune kept 46 files of an unrecognised shape, `*-manifest.json.tmp`. The script keeps unknown shapes by design and says so in its log. Their size is inside the 33.3 MB. Not filed unless they accumulate across runs. The next readings will show whether they do.

**Next:** #25452 step 3, the pool reading after ≥ 5 merges, by whoever can read `actions/cache/*` (the seat container gets 403 there).
